summary: Current raw OPFS composite AbortSignal remains packaged head; linked rev0196 closes the guarded Web-Lock lifecycle gap where close changed local state but did not abort queued lock acquisition or in-flight provider signals. Guarded stores now own and compose a close AbortSignal into lock/provider options, re-check closed state after acquisition, expose closeSignalAborted/closeAbortSignals, and the coordinator preserves abortReasonCode so close-owned cancellation provenance survives pre-acquisition aborts.
nonClaims: No Web Lock fairness, quota reservation, eviction survival, fsync durability, Storage Buckets support, Service Worker lifetime, crash recovery, or cross-browser proof.
Close-owned cancellation is local lifecycle hygiene; it does not prove process/tab termination recovery.
